goal: Present the existing SSWR1 summoner-to-Master WHISPER as a readable native WIM whisper from the summoner, suppress the legacy SummonRelay default-chat mirror, keep technical packets invisible, and route replies through canonical /ssr without adding any direct customer-send path.
notes: Live evidence showed relay data arriving only as the legacy SummonRelay DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME mirror. Updater packaging was verified to contain the prior WIM bridge, so the failure is presentation rather than delivery. This revision replaces the existing WhisperRelayWimNativeHot slot instead of adding another hot module, reducing that file from about 11.1 KB to about 9.6 KB and preserving the native watcher payload cap. The real SSWR1 CHAT_MSG_WHISPER is consumed before WIM's Block filter: I/IB/IC render in the summoner WIM as [Customer] raw text, confirmed WHISPER_OUT_* E events render as [to Customer], and H/K/R/lifecycle control remains hidden. The legacy SummonRelay chat mirror is suppressed only when WIM is available. WIM replies reuse exact-session canonical /ssr routing; this module contains no direct SendChatMessage call. Stable pass-through global wrappers avoid the earlier dangling-wrapper nil failure. Live behavior still requires in-game proof after exact-SHA delivery.
